response.title: which power station runs an espresso machine for the most cups
response.answer:
For running an espresso machine, the best portable power station is generally the one with the largest battery capacity (Wh) and enough AC output power (W) to operate the machine.

The important distinction is:

Battery capacity (Wh) determines how many cups you can make.

AC output (W) determines whether the espresso machine can run at all.

Inverter efficiency affects how much of the stored energy actually reaches the machine.

Most home espresso machines draw approximately 1,000–1,800 W while heating, but they don't draw that continuously throughout every shot.

For maximum cups, I'd focus on power stations with at least 2,000 W of continuous AC output and 3–6 kWh of battery capacity, or larger expandable systems.

Best power stations for the most espresso cups

Assuming an espresso machine uses 40 Wh per cup, including a share of warm-up energy, and allowing 85% usable battery energy:
